name: Claude Seo Skill
description: A comprehensive SEO and AI search optimization (AEO) toolkit for Claude Code. Provides 13 slash commands covering keyword research with clustering and intent mapping, technical site audits scored 0-100, on-page content scoring with E-E-A-T analysis, JSON-LD schema generation, Google Business Profile 30-day posting calendars, competitor backlink analysis with 90-day outreach plans, and AI search optimization for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT. Built for agencies with multi-client...
longDescription:
Ships **6 skills** and **14 commands**.

- **Skills** (6): `seo-aeo` (AI Search Optimization (AEO / Answer Engine Optimization): optimize for Google AI Overviews, Perplexity citations, ChatGPT mentions), `seo-backlinks` (Backlink analysis and link building strategy: competitor backlink profiling, outreach plan generation, monthly SEO reporting framework, toxic link…), `seo-content` (Content optimization for SEO: on-page scoring (0-100), E-E-A-T analysis, title/meta optimization, heading structure, keyword density, SERP preview, content…), `seo-keywords` (Revenue-focused keyword research and strategy for SEO campaigns), `seo-local` (Local SEO optimization: Google Business Profile post generation, 30-day posting calendars, NAP consistency checks, local citation audits, review…), `seo-technical-audit` (Full technical SEO site audit: crawlability, indexability, speed, mobile, schema markup validation with JSON-LD generation, internal linking analysis,…)
- **Commands** (14): `aeo-check` (Check a brand's visibility in AI search engines (Google AI Overview, Perplexity, ChatGPT)), `audit` (Run a full technical SEO audit on a website with prioritized fix list), `brand-serp` (Analyze and optimize what appears when someone searches your brand name), `cannibalization` (Find pages on the same site competing for the same keywords with fix recommendations), `content-decay` (Detect stale or declining content that needs refreshing with priority ranking), `enhance-aeo` (Deep AI search discovery — mine real questions people ask LLMs, test your keywords across AI engines, and…), `gbp-calendar` (Generate a 30-day Google Business Profile posting calendar with ready-to-publish posts), `keywords` (Run keyword research for a topic or URL with clustering and intent mapping), and 6 more

Installs with `claude plugin install claude-seo-skill@claude-community` from `mangollc/claude-seo-skill`.
